arguments.query: SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, b.flight_id, b.passenger_id, b.amount_cents, c.charge_id, c.provider_state, c.amount_cents as charge_amount, h.hold_id FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id ORDER BY b.booking_id

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, b.flight_id, b.passenger_id, b.amount_cents, c.charge_id, c.state, c.amount_cents as charge_amount, h.hold_id FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id ORDER BY b.booking_id
SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, COUNT(c.charge_id) as charge_count, b.amount_cents FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE c.state = "captured" GROUP BY b.booking_id
SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, c.state as charge_state FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = "confirmed"
SELECT COUNT(*) as pending_count FROM charges WHERE state = "pending"
